bio:
I'm a first-year engineering student at Purdue, planning to major in Electrical Engineering. I grew up in Logansport, Indiana, where my parents run Manor Motel by themselves. I started helping out there when I was 14.

Before college I ran a web development business for local clients, including Jim Kitchell Agency, Priceless Banners, and Blooms & Sweets. I also interned at Compal, doing CAD work in Fusion 360 on medical refrigeration components.

At Purdue I do PCB design for Lunabotics, and I'm on the EPICS Assistive Technology team and Purdue Venture Consulting. This winter I'm interning at Whallon Machinery.

Outside engineering I study Spanish and read Hindu philosophy.
